webPolicies.rule: browserVirtualKey reads KeyboardEvent.key, code, location, Ctrl/Alt/Meta/AltGraph and isComposing; never keyCode, which or charCode. An ASCII letter in key (either case, Shift allowed, location 0, non-empty code) is VK 65 + letter index; the letter follows the layout's interpreted key and code is only the physical identity of a hold. Keypad digits need location 3, code NumpadN and the same digit as key (NumLock on) -> VK 96 + N; keypad decimal needs location 3, code NumpadDecimal and key '.' or ',' -> VK 110.
